name: agentcore-harness
description: Three roles on Bedrock-native AgentCore Runtimes: Claude Code = backend builder (implements the backend deliverable as an AgentCore MCP server), a second Claude Code = validator (authors a self-contained executable check whose real exit code is the gate), opencode = frontend builder (builds the interface). Skills cover per-agent setup/deploy, the Gateway MCP, the harness lifecycle, and extending the harness. Fire-and-forget orchestration, no race and no winner.
